prompt: Write an email to a colleague apologizing for missing yesterday's project meeting. Explain briefly why and propose a time to catch up this week.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Jordan,

I'm sorry I missed yesterday's project meeting. I had an urgent client call that ran longer than expected. Could we meet Thursday at 2 p.m. so you can fill me in on the action items?

Thanks,
Alex

prompt: Write a short memo announcing that the office will close early at 3 p.m. this Friday for a staff appreciation event. Mention refreshments will be provided.
sampleAnswer:
MEMO
To: All Staff
From: Administration
Re: Early Closing This Friday

Please note the office will close at 3 p.m. this Friday for a staff appreciation event. Light refreshments will be provided in the lobby. Enjoy the afternoon!

prompt: Write an email to a hotel requesting a late checkout on Sunday and confirming that breakfast is included in your reservation.
sampleAnswer:
Dear Front Desk,

I am staying with you this weekend under confirmation #HG4421. Could I request a late checkout on Sunday, preferably until 1 p.m.? Also, please confirm that breakfast is included in my rate.

Thank you,
Mei Chen

prompt: Write a brief online review (4–6 sentences) of a restaurant you recently visited for a business lunch. Mention food quality, service, and whether you would return.
sampleAnswer: I took a client to Harbor Bistro last week for lunch. The seared tuna was fresh and beautifully presented, and our server was attentive without being intrusive. We were seated promptly even though we arrived a few minutes early. The bill was reasonable for the quality. I would definitely return for future client meals.

prompt: Summarize in one paragraph the key points of a meeting where the team decided to delay a product launch by two weeks and assign two engineers to bug fixes.
sampleAnswer: In today's meeting, the team agreed to delay the product launch by two weeks to address critical bugs. Two engineers will be reassigned full-time to bug fixes until release readiness is confirmed. Marketing will update the launch materials accordingly, and we will reconvene next Friday for a status check.

prompt: Write an email requesting information about a vendor's bulk pricing for 500 units of office chairs, including delivery time to Taipei.
sampleAnswer:
Dear Sales Team,

We are interested in purchasing 500 office chairs for our Taipei office. Could you please send bulk pricing, available models, and estimated delivery time to Taipei?

I look forward to your reply.
Best regards,
Chris Wong

prompt: Write a polite message declining an invitation to join an optional weekend training workshop because of a prior family commitment. Suggest you may attend the next session.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for inviting me to the weekend workshop. Unfortunately I have a family commitment that day, so I won't be able to attend. Please keep me on the list for the next session if one is scheduled.

Best,
Rita

prompt: Write an email to your manager requesting approval for a two-day business trip to Singapore next month to meet a key client. Include approximate dates and purpose.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Morgan,

I'd like to request approval for a two-day trip to Singapore around mid-October to meet our key client, Apex Retail. The meetings would cover contract renewal and Q4 order forecasts. Please let me know if this works with the budget.

Thanks,
Daniel

prompt: A customer received a damaged package. Write a customer-service reply apologizing, offering a replacement, and asking for a photo of the damage.
sampleAnswer:
Dear Ms. Torres,

We are sorry your package arrived damaged. We will gladly send a replacement at no charge. Please reply with a photo of the damage so we can process this quickly and improve our packaging.

Sincerely,
Customer Care

prompt: Write three bullet-point action items after a sales meeting: follow up with Client A, revise the proposal price, and schedule a demo for next Tuesday.
sampleAnswer:
Action Items:
• Follow up with Client A by email within 24 hours
• Revise the proposal price and recirculate by Friday
• Schedule a product demo for next Tuesday

prompt: Write a short notice for the company intranet reminding employees to update emergency contact information in the HR portal by the end of the month.
sampleAnswer: Reminder: Please update your emergency contact information in the HR portal by the end of this month. Accurate contacts help us reach your family quickly if needed. Thank you for your cooperation.

prompt: Write an email to a catering company confirming an order for 30 sandwich lunch boxes for a workshop on Sept 18 at 12:30 p.m., and ask about vegetarian options.
sampleAnswer:
Hello,

I'd like to confirm an order of 30 sandwich lunch boxes for our workshop on September 18 at 12:30 p.m. Could you also let us know how many vegetarian options are available and the total cost?

Thank you,
Office Coordinator

prompt: Write a thank-you email after a job interview. Mention one specific topic discussed and restate your interest in the role.
sampleAnswer:
Dear Ms. Gomez,

Thank you for meeting with me today. I especially enjoyed discussing your team's approach to regional sales analytics. I remain very interested in the Analyst position and would welcome the opportunity to contribute.

Sincerely,
Kevin Lin

prompt: Write a complaint email to an airline about a delayed flight that caused you to miss a connection. Request compensation or rebooking assistance.
sampleAnswer:
Dear Customer Relations,

My flight AA210 on September 9 was delayed three hours, causing me to miss my connecting flight to Taipei. Please assist with rebooking and advise what compensation is available for the inconvenience.

Booking reference: M9K2PL
Regards,
Hannah Wu

prompt: Write a short paragraph proposing an agenda for a one-hour team meeting: 10 minutes updates, 30 minutes brainstorming, 15 minutes decisions, 5 minutes wrap-up.
sampleAnswer: Proposed agenda for our one-hour team meeting: we will start with 10 minutes of quick project updates, followed by 30 minutes of brainstorming on the new campaign. We will then spend 15 minutes deciding next steps and owners, and close with a 5-minute wrap-up of action items.
